title: Step 2: bounded-below etale origins for uniform towers
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite extension E/Q_ell, a scheme T, abelian coefficient-tower data D [det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian] and a section-normalized realization base b [def-sp-tower-shriek-realization]. If K is an ordinary derived coefficient tower with uniform bounded constructible finite-Tor levels [sk-def-sp-normalized-towers], then the realized tower is bounded below, and each positive level has a retained fixed-coefficient etale origin [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness, det-sp-tower-shriek-levels]. No Noetherianity, finite-type or transition-normalization hypothesis is required for this domain assertion, and no coherence between the etale origins is asserted.

source.place: Step 2: bounded-below etale origins for uniform towers; source of the expanded standing-setting restriction in lem-sp-tower-p1-uniform-ctf-domains

proof.text: Choose a common lower cohomological endpoint from the uniform tower predicate. Exact level evaluation commutes with homology; all components of a homology tower below that endpoint vanish, so its identity is zero componentwise. Exact realization preserves this lower bound.

For each n apply finiteRing_constructibleDerived_origin to the bounded intrinsically constructible level. The bounded constructible etale antecedent is bounded below. Factor the specified comparison through fixed-coefficient comparison and the canonical constant-ring realization equivalence. The realization counit and section-normalized level evaluation identify its image with the evaluation of the realized tower. Retain its comparison image as the Plus level and the original antecedent and isomorphism as FixedEtaleOriginWitness. This gives Origin independently for each n.
